Using AutoStacc

Collections, tags and saved searches

Organise Your Stacc your own way with collections, tags and saved searches. Only you see them.

On this page

  1. Collections
  2. Tags
  3. Saved searches
  4. When files leave

Last updated October 16, 2026

With an account you can organise Your Stacc your own way. Nobody else sees it, and it never changes what creators said about their files.

Collections

  1. Tick the files you want.
  2. Choose Add to, then an existing collection or a new one.
  3. Use the Collection menu to see one collection. Inside it you can take files out, rename the collection or delete it; the files stay in Your Stacc.

You can have up to 100 collections of up to 2,000 files each.

Tags

Tick files and choose Tag to label them with your own words: lowercase letters or numbers, up to 30 characters. Tags show on each file with ✕ to remove one, the Tag menu filters by one, and search finds them. Up to 20 tags per file.

Saved searches

With a search or filter on, Save search keeps it as a link at the top of Your Stacc. Up to 50.

When files leave

Collections and tags follow a file through a pack's updates. If a file stops being yours (it was removed in an update and its 30 days passed, or the order was refunded), it isn't listed any more: the collection says how many are gone, with Clear them.
